Pulani ya vuhumelerisi - PRIVATE {note}; plan (swi ya
mahlweni)
Nhlangula 2026 ku fika eka Ndzhati 2027


  Ndlela leyi tinhlayo ti hlayelwaka ha yona

  A ku kombisiwi nhlayo ya tikhilogireme hikuva pulani leyi a yi na xibyariwa lexi nga ni mpimo wa ntshovelo wa
  swakudya wa kg/m² lowu tiyisisiweke.
  Mpimo lowu nga kumekiki a hi ntshovelo wa 0kg. Rhekhoda mintshovelo ya xiviri eka phepha ra rhekhodo ya
  n’hweti.

  Leswaku u nga yi tshemba ku fika kwihi pulani leyi

  A ku na mutivi wa vurimi loyi a kambeke pulani leyi. Yi sekeriwe eka mepe wa wena, eka datha ya maxelo ni
  misava leyi pimiweke hi tisathalayiti ni timodele ta misava hinkwaro, ni le ka swiletelo swa ku byala swa
  Afrika-Dzonga leswi kandziyisiweke. Yi hlanganisiwe hi vukheta ni hi xikongomelo lexinene — kambe i
  masungulo, a hi xileriso.
  Tirhisa ni ku avanyisa ka wena na wona. Khomphyuta a yi swi koti ku vona misava ya wena. A yi tivi laha mati ma
  yimaka kona endzhaku ka mpfula ya ntamu, leswaku gwitsi ri tshamaka ekhoneni rihi, leswi tsandzekeke laha
  lembe leri hundzeke, kumbe leswi ndyangu wa wena wu nga ta swi dya hakunene. Wena wa swi tiva.
  Nhlayo ya misava hi yona leyi nga ha vaka ni xihoxo ngopfu. Ya hina yi huma eka modele ya misava hinkwaro
  leyi hlayaka ndhawu leyikulu, naswona misava ya xiviri yi nga cinca ku suka etlhelo rin'we ra nsimu yin'we ku ya
  eka lerin'wana. Loko nhlayo yin'wana ni yin'wana laha yi ri ya nkoka eka xiboho lexi u nga ta tirhisa mali eka
  xona, xikambelo xa misava hi xona ntsena ndlela yo tiva. U nga nghenisa xiviko xa xona kutani pulani yi ta
  akiwa hi vuntshwa hi tinhlayo ta wena ta xiviri.
  Komba leswi mutsundzuxi wa swa vurimi wa laha kusuhi. Va tiva xifundzantsongo xa wena, mpfula ya wena ni
  switsotswana swa wena hi ndlela leyi modele yi nga yi tiviki, naswona va nga lulamisa hi timinete ta khume
  leswi a swi ta ku lahlekisela nguva. A swi durhi mali, naswona hi swona swa nkoka ngopfu leswi u nga swi
  endlaka hi tsalwa leri.
  Langutela leswaku swin'wana swi ta va ni swihoxo. Tsala leswi u swi byaleke hakunene ni leswi u swi tshoveleke
  hakunene. Nguva yin'wana ni yin'wana leyi u yi rhekhodaka yi endla leswaku pulani leyi landzelaka yi fambelana
  ni misava ya wena ku antswa ku hundza leyi — hi wona xikongomelo xa yona.
  Minkarhi ya ku wupfa leyi kandziyisiweke ya swiyimo leswinene ngopfu i tindhawu ta ku hlela, a hi
  switshembiso. Loko xibyariwa lexi landzelaka xi nga si byariwa kumbe ku susiwa xi byariwa kun'wana, tiyisisa
  leswaku xibyariwa xa khale xi herile ni leswaku mubedo a wu na xona hakunene; swibyariwa swi nga wupfa
  endzhaku ka nkarhi.

  Ndlela leyi pulani leyi yi hlanganisiweke ha yona

  Swi huma eka pulani leyi ringanyetiweke hi Nhlangula 2026. Lexi cinciweke hi voko endzhaku ka nkarhi wolowo
  a xi hlamuseriwi laha.
  Vuhundzuluxeri bya tinotsi ta pulani leti hlayisiweke i matsalwa yo sungula lama nga si kamberiwaka. Xinghezi
  xo sungula xa kumeka ehansi ka notsi yin'wana ni yin'wana leyi hundzuluxeriweke. Tinotsi leti nga si
  hundzuluxeriwaka ti sala hi Xinghezi.

  LESWI FANELEKE KU LANGUTIWA

  Ku longoloxa swibyariwa swa ku xavisa ku pimanisa ntsena mimpimo ya le hansi leyi tekiwaka ya ntiko wa
  ntshovelo lowuntshwa hi kg/m² eka ndzhendzeleko wun'wana ni wun'wana wa xibyariwa. A swi pimi mpindzulo,
  swakudya swa miri, xilaveko xa vaxavi kumbe ntshovelo wa lembe wa le henhla swinene hi ku angarhela; tirhisa
  vuxokoxoko bya wena bya vaxavi ni minxavo u nga si nyikela misava eka swibyariwa.
  Notsi ya pulani ya Xinghezi xo sungula: Commercial ranking compares conservative fresh-weight kg/m² per
  crop cycle only. It does not estimate profit, nutrition, buyer demand or a global annual maximum; use your own
  buyer and price information before committing land.
  Pulani leyi titshegeke hi mpfula: xibyariwa xi byariwa ntsena laha n'hweti yin'wana ni yin'wana leyi xi kulaka ha
  yona yi kumaka mpfula ya kwalomu ka hafu ya ku haha ka mati loku pimiweke (nawu wa FAO wa nkarhi wa ku
  kula, ku tirhisiwa mpfula ya n'hweti yin'wana ni yin'wana ya ndhawu leyi; ku haha ka mati ku pimiwa hi mahiselo
  hi endlelo ra Thornthwaite, leri nga swi pimaka ehansi etindhawini to oma leti nga ni moya). Mpfula ya avhareji
  a hi mpfula ya lembe rin'wana ni rin'wana — cheleta hi nkarhi wo oma loko u swi kota.
  Notsi ya pulani ya Xinghezi xo sungula: Rain-fed plan: a crop is only sown where every month it grows gets rain
  of at least half the estimated evaporation (the FAO growing-period rule, using this site's monthly rainfall;
  evaporation estimated from temperature by Thornthwaite's method, which can under-estimate it in dry, windy
  places). Average rain is not every year's rain — water in a dry spell if you can.
  Nhlayo ya vanhu lava u va phamelaka a yi tirhisiwi ku vhumbha leswaku u byala swo tala ku fikela kwihi.
  Mupulani u ringeta swona swibyariwa leswi u swi hlawuleke; ndhawu ya wena leyi nga emepeni, minkarhi ya ku
  byala ni ku cincana ka swibyariwa swi hlawula leswi ringanaka.
  Notsi ya pulani ya Xinghezi xo sungula: How many people you feed is not used to guess how much to plant. The
  planner tries the exact crops you chose; your mapped space, the sowing windows and crop rotation decide
  what fits.
  Swibyariwa swo funengeta misava swi timiwile eka nhlawulo wa swibyariwa, hikokwalaho nsimu yin'wana ni
  yin'wana yi wisa endzhaku ka xibyariwa xa yona xa ximumu ematshan'weni yo kuma broad beans kumbe oats
  swo funengeta misava hi vuxika.
  Notsi ya pulani ya Xinghezi xo sungula: Cover crops is switched off in the crop mix, so each plot rests after its
  summer crop instead of getting a winter cover of broad beans or oats.

  LESWI HLAWURIWEKE HI PULANI LEYI

  Ku hava xibyariwa lexi u xi hlawuleke lexi koteke ku vekiwa eka nkarhi lowu — nkarhi wa xona wa ku byala a wu
  fiki hi nkarhi, kumbe ku hava ndhawu yo byala eka mepe wa wena leyi nga ni xivumbeko lexi xi faneleke.
  Kambela nkarhi wa ku byala wa laha kumbe u engetela xibyariwa hi voko; leswi a hi vumbhoni bya leswaku
  xibyariwa a xi koti ku kula laha.
  Notsi ya pulani ya Xinghezi xo sungula: None of the crops you chose could be placed this round — either their
  sowing window does not come round in time, or no growing area on your map has the right shape for them.
  Check the local window or add a crop by hand; this is not proof that the crop cannot grow here.
  Kambela n'hweti yin'wana ni yin'wana ya ku byala ni mutsundzuxi wa swa vurimi wa laha — khalendara leyi yi
  kamberiwile xibyariwa hi xibyariwa eka KwaZulu-Natal ntsena.
  Notsi ya pulani ya Xinghezi xo sungula: Check each sowing month with your local extension officer — this
  calendar has been checked crop by crop only for KwaZulu-Natal.

  LESWI HLAWURIWEKE HI PULANI LEYI (swi ya mahlweni)

  Maize a yi vekiwanga eka pulani ya wena: app yi nga pima ndhawu leyi nga emepeni, kambe a yi koti ku dirowa
  kumbe ku kambela buloko ya maize leyi rhurhisaka mungu hi moya. Engetela nsimu ya swakudya swa
  masungulo emepeni, kumbe u engetela maize hi voko loko u kamberile malongoloxelo ya xiviri ya mintila.
  Notsi ya pulani ya Xinghezi xo sungula: Maize was not placed for you: the app can measure mapped area, but it
  cannot draw or check a wind-pollinated maize block. Add a staple plot on the map, or add maize by hand once
  you have checked the real row layout.

  MISAVA LEYI NGA RIKI NA KU BYALA LOKUNTSWHA

  N'hweti ya sweswi a yi nga kumeki, hikokwalaho swiringanyeto swi sungula hi Sunguti.
  Notsi ya pulani ya Xinghezi xo sungula: The current month was unavailable, so suggestions start from January.
  Tinhweti leti ta ku byala ti landzela khalendara ya KZN DARD ya tindhawu to kufumela. Ehandle ka
  KwaZulu-Natal, ti tiyisise ni mutsundzuxi wa swa vurimi wa laha.
  Notsi ya pulani ya Xinghezi xo sungula: These sowing months follow the KZN DARD warm-area calendar.
  Outside KwaZulu-Natal, confirm them with your local extension officer.
  Ku ni mubedo wun'we ntsena lowu nga tirhisiwiki — wu vekeriwe ku phamela ndyangu; engetela mibedo
  yin'wana leswaku yin'wana yi vekeriwa ku xavisa.
  Notsi ya pulani ya Xinghezi xo sungula: Only one bed free — kept it for feeding the family; add more beds to
  also set some aside for selling.
  Notsi yo sungula ya pulani leyi hlayisiweke: PRIVATE {count}, {note}; $& <kept> 03.50 m²

  NDLELA LEYI PULANI LEYI YI ENDLIWEKE HA YONA

  Ku hava pulani ya swibyariwa leyi endliweke hi yoxe hikuva ncheleto lowu tiyeke a wu nga tiyisisiwanga
  naswona mpfula ni mahiselo swa n'hweti yin'wana ni yin'wana swa ndhawu leyi a swi nga kumeki leswaku ku
  kunguhatiwa nguva leyi titshegeke hi mpfula. Endlelo leri ri hlanganisa hi vomu mindzhendzeleko leyi
  landzelelanaka ya swibyariwa, naswona vito ra mpfula ya xifundzha a ri tiyisisi leswaku purasi leri ri nga swi
  nyika mati.
  Notsi ya pulani ya Xinghezi xo sungula: No automatic crop plan was generated because reliable irrigation was
  not confirmed and this site's own monthly rainfall and temperature were not available to plan a rain-fed
  season. This engine deliberately packs successive crop cycles, and a regional rainfall label does not prove that
  this farm can water them.
  Ku hava xibyariwa lexi muti lowu wu xi hlawuleke lexi nga ni xiyimiso lexi tiyisisiweke xa ku pulana hi xoxe.
  Kambela swibyariwa swoleswo hi voko kumbe u hlawula lexi mupulani a nga xi vekelaka xiyimiso; a nge vhumbi
  xo swi siva.
  Notsi ya pulani ya Xinghezi xo sungula: None of the crops this household chose has a verified schedule for
  automatic planning. Review those crops by hand or choose one the planner can schedule; it will not guess a
  substitute.
  Ku hlawuriwe mintshovelo yi nga ri yingani leyikulu: xibyariwa xin'wana ni xin'wana xi byariwa hi vunyingi
  kan'we hi nkarhi, naswona ku byala ka xona loku landzelaka ku sungula ntsena endzhaku ka loko ntshovelo
  wolowo wu herile. A ku engeteriwanga ku byala kutsongo ka n'hweti yin'wana ni yin'wana.
